slides.texte_overlay:
things that will make you
disguistingly intelligent

reading out of your lane

read one book a month from a section of the bookshop you never visit. the most interesting ideas you'll ever find live where different fields quietly meet.

keeping a question list

write down every question that pops into your head during the day. look up three of them each evening, and watch your curiosity turn into real knowledge.

learning a few words

learn five words a week in a language you'd love to speak. even a little of a second language changes how you hear your own and keeps your memory sharp.

a daily lesson

spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in something new: philosophy, astronomy, art history. small daily lessons build the wide mind people call disgustingly intelligent.

slides.texte_overlay:
arguing the other side

once a week, argue the opposite of something you believe, out loud. understanding the other side properly makes your own thinking much sharper and more honest.
